scenario.title: Materialise the whole staging layer as tables (folder-level config)
scenario.description: One line in dbt_project.yml turns five staging views into tables rebuilt daily (copies of the largest source tables).

main.name: stg_orders
main.sql:
select
    o_orderkey      as order_key,
    o_custkey       as customer_key,
    o_orderstatus   as order_status,
    o_totalprice    as total_price,
    o_orderdate     as order_date,
    o_orderpriority as order_priority,
    o_clerk         as clerk,
    o_shippriority  as ship_priority,
    o_comment       as order_comment
from "lab"."raw"."orders"

main.name: customer_features
main.sql:
with orders as (
    select customer_key, order_key, order_date, total_price
    from "lab"."ci_main"."stg_orders"
    where order_date <= cast('1998-08-02' as date)
)
select
    customer_key,
    count(*)         as order_count,
    sum(total_price) as lifetime_value,
    avg(total_price) as avg_order_value,
    min(order_date)  as first_order_date,
    max(order_date)  as last_order_date,
    
        (date_diff('day', max(order_date)::timestamp, cast('1998-08-02' as date)::timestamp ))
     as days_since_last_order
from orders
group by customer_key

main.name: stg_lineitem
main.sql:
select
    l_orderkey      as order_key,
    l_partkey       as part_key,
    l_suppkey       as supplier_key,
    l_linenumber    as line_number,
    l_quantity      as quantity,
    l_extendedprice as extended_price,
    l_discount      as discount,
    l_tax           as tax,
    l_returnflag    as return_flag,
    l_linestatus    as line_status,
    l_shipdate      as ship_date,
    l_commitdate    as commit_date,
    l_receiptdate   as receipt_date,
    l_shipinstruct  as ship_instruct,
    l_shipmode      as ship_mode,
    l_comment       as line_comment
from "lab"."raw"."lineitem"

main.name: customer_ltv_monthly
main.sql:
with lines as (
    select
        o.customer_key,
        o.order_key,
        o.order_date,
        (l.extended_price * (1 - l.discount)) as revenue
    from "lab"."ci_main"."stg_orders" o
    join "lab"."ci_main"."stg_lineitem" l on l.order_key = o.order_key
    where o.order_date <= cast('1998-08-02' as date)
),
monthly as (
    select
        customer_key,
        date_trunc('month', order_date) as order_month,
        sum(revenue)              as revenue,
        count(distinct order_key) as order_count
    from lines
    group by 1, 2
)
select
    customer_key,
    order_month,
    revenue,
    order_count,
    sum(revenue) over (partition by customer_key order by order_month
                       rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as cumulative_revenue,
    min(order_month) over (partition by customer_key)                     as cohort_month
from monthly

main.name: stg_customers
main.sql:
select
    c.c_custkey    as customer_key,
    c.c_name       as customer_name,
    c.c_mktsegment as market_segment,
    c.c_acctbal    as account_balance,
    n.n_name       as nation_name,
    r.r_name       as region_name
from "lab"."raw"."customer" c
join "lab"."raw"."nation" n on n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey
join "lab"."raw"."region" r on r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey

main.name: dim_customers
main.sql:
select
    c.customer_key,
    c.customer_name,
    c.market_segment,
    c.account_balance,
    c.nation_name,
    c.region_name,
    coalesce(f.order_count, 0) as order_count,
    f.lifetime_value,
    f.avg_order_value,
    f.first_order_date,
    f.last_order_date,
    f.days_since_last_order
from "lab"."ci_main"."stg_customers" c
left join "lab"."ci_main"."customer_features" f on f.customer_key = c.customer_key

main.name: fct_daily_revenue
main.sql:
select
    l.ship_date,
    count(*)                                                 as line_count,
    sum(l.quantity)                                          as total_quantity,
    sum((l.extended_price * (1 - l.discount))) as net_revenue,
    sum(case when l.return_flag = 'R'
             then (l.extended_price * (1 - l.discount))
             else 0 end)                                     as returned_revenue
from "lab"."ci_main"."stg_lineitem" l
where l.ship_date <= cast('1998-08-02' as date)

  and l.ship_date > cast(

    (cast('1998-08-02' as date) + cast(-3 as bigint) * interval 1 day) as date)

group by l.ship_date

main.name: int_order_lines
main.sql:
select
    l.order_key,
    l.line_number,
    l.part_key,
    l.supplier_key,
    o.customer_key,
    o.order_date,
    o.order_priority,
    l.ship_date,
    l.ship_mode,
    l.return_flag,
    l.quantity,
    l.extended_price,
    l.discount,
    (l.extended_price * (1 - l.discount)) as net_revenue,
    l.line_comment,
    o.order_comment
from "lab"."ci_main"."stg_lineitem" l
join "lab"."ci_main"."stg_orders" o on o.order_key = l.order_key
where l.ship_date > cast(

    (cast('1998-08-02' as date) + cast(-180 as bigint) * interval 1 day) as date)
  and l.ship_date <= cast('1998-08-02' as date)
  and l.return_flag <> 'R'

main.name: stg_partsupp
main.sql:
select
    ps_partkey    as part_key,
    ps_suppkey    as supplier_key,
    ps_availqty   as available_qty,
    ps_supplycost as supply_cost
from "lab"."raw"."partsupp"

main.name: stg_parts
main.sql:
select
    p_partkey     as part_key,
    p_name        as part_name,
    p_brand       as brand,
    p_type        as part_type,
    p_size        as part_size,
    p_retailprice as retail_price
from "lab"."raw"."part"

main.name: part_supplier_costs
main.sql:
select
    p.part_key,
    p.part_name,
    p.brand,
    p.part_type,
    count(*)              as supplier_count,
    min(ps.supply_cost)   as min_supply_cost,
    avg(ps.supply_cost)   as avg_supply_cost,
    sum(ps.available_qty) as total_available_qty
from "lab"."ci_main"."stg_partsupp" ps
join "lab"."ci_main"."stg_parts" p on p.part_key = ps.part_key
group by p.part_key, p.part_name, p.brand, p.part_type

main.name: mart_part_profitability
main.sql:
select
    ol.part_key,
    pc.part_name,
    pc.brand,
    sum(ol.quantity)                                            as quantity_sold,
    sum(ol.net_revenue)                                         as net_revenue,
    sum(ol.net_revenue) - sum(ol.quantity * pc.min_supply_cost) as est_margin
from "lab"."ci_main"."int_order_lines" ol
join "lab"."ci_main"."part_supplier_costs" pc on pc.part_key = ol.part_key
group by ol.part_key, pc.part_name, pc.brand

main.name: mart_revenue_by_nation
main.sql:
select
    c.nation_name,
    c.region_name,
    date_trunc('month', ol.ship_date) as ship_month,
    count(distinct ol.order_key)                    as order_count,
    sum(ol.net_revenue)                             as net_revenue
from "lab"."ci_main"."int_order_lines" ol
join "lab"."ci_main"."dim_customers" c on c.customer_key = ol.customer_key
group by 1, 2, 3
having date_trunc('month', ol.ship_date)
       >= date_trunc('month', cast(

    (cast('1998-08-02' as date) + cast(-3 as bigint) * interval 1 month) as date))

main.name: rpt_customer_segments
main.sql:
select
    market_segment,
    nation_name,
    count(*)            as customer_count,
    avg(lifetime_value) as avg_lifetime_value,
    sum(order_count)    as order_count
from "lab"."ci_main"."dim_customers"
group by 1, 2

main.name: rpt_daily_kpis
main.sql:
select
    ship_date,
    net_revenue,
    returned_revenue,
    line_count,
    avg(net_revenue) over (order by ship_date rows between 6 preceding and current row) as net_revenue_7d_avg
from "lab"."ci_main"."fct_daily_revenue"
where ship_date > cast(

    (cast('1998-08-02' as date) + cast(-30 as bigint) * interval 1 day) as date)

main.name: bi_segments_dashboard
main.sql: select * from "lab"."ci_main"."rpt_customer_segments" order by customer_count desc

main.name: bi_nation_trend
main.sql: select nation_name, ship_month, sum(net_revenue) as net_revenue from "lab"."ci_main"."mart_revenue_by_nation" group by 1, 2
